title: Reinforcement learning for intensive care medicine: actionable clinical insights from novel approaches to reward shaping and off-policy model evaluation

content.abstract_summary: A clinical RL study develops cross off-policy evaluation, policy restriction, and policy inspection for ventilator-setting decisions using ICU data.
key_findings: Cross-OPE exposed reward-sensitive suboptimal policies that appeared acceptable under an initial evaluation.
Policy restrictions were used to prevent potentially hazardous actions.
Individual-policy inspection supported interpretation beyond aggregate policy value.
limitations: ICU ventilation use case is not a PK/PD dosing study; transfer requires pharmacometric-specific causal and model-qualification analysis.

gaps_addressed: Safety-oriented OPE, policy restrictions, and interpretable review for offline dosing policies

provenance.notes: Focused causal-offline-RL search; open full text available through PubMed Central.
